item_name: Rothco Deluxe Low Profile Special Forces Insignia Cap
item_short_desc: Show your pride and support with Rothco’s Deluxe Low Profile Special Forces Insignia Cap. Crafted from 100% brushed cotton twill, this cap is as durable as it is stylish. The front panel features a raised 3-D embroidered Special Forces insignia and the bold motto, “Mess With The Best, Die Like The Rest.” The text “Special Forces” is also embroidered on both the front panel and the sandwich brim for an added touch of distinction.
